title: Healthy vs Unhealthy Relationships: The Real Test 🚩 #Shorts
description:
We often mistake intense chemistry for a healthy connection. But the real difference between a healthy and an unhealthy relationship isn't how good the highs feel—it's how safe you feel when things get uncomfortable.

🚩 In an unhealthy dynamic, conflict is a battle for control. Boundaries are treated as threats, and disagreements are met with guilt trips, silent treatment, or explosive anger. You end up walking on eggshells, editing yourself just to keep the peace.

🌱 A healthy relationship isn't the absence of conflict—it's the presence of emotional safety. Differences are met with curiosity instead of contempt. When tension rises, the two of you team up against the problem, not against each other.

THE LITMUS TEST:
Observe what happens when you set a simple boundary. 
A healthy partner responds with curiosity and respect. 
An unhealthy dynamic responds with guilt, withdrawal, or defensiveness.

That isn't passion—it's control. Always choose consistent safety over chaotic intensity.
